user_message: Run standard QC and clustering on this PBMC data, and show me a UMAP.

steps.rationale: Compute per-cell QC metrics (total_counts, n_genes_by_counts, pct_counts_mt) before any filtering.
Remove low-count cells using the total_counts column produced by calculate_qc_metrics.
Drop genes detected in fewer than 3 cells.
Median-depth normalize then log1p so downstream steps see a stabilized scale.
Select 2000 HVGs (provisional default) so PCA focuses on informative genes.
Linear dimensionality reduction on HVGs; feeds the neighbor graph.
Build the kNN graph on X_pca shared by UMAP and Leiden.
2D embedding for visualization from the neighbor graph.
Graph-based clustering on the neighbor graph (resolution provisional).
Render the UMAP colored by Leiden cluster.

plan.rationale: Canonical standard_scrnaseq QC-through-clustering path: QC metrics, cell/gene filtering, normalization, HVG selection, PCA, neighbor graph, UMAP, Leiden clustering, and a UMAP figure. Seeds are threaded for reproducibility; biology defaults are provisional pending LSM review.

user_message: Compare gene expression between treated and control samples for each cell type.

steps.rationale: Aggregate raw counts to one pseudobulk profile per (sample, cell_type) to restore replicate-level variance and avoid pseudo-replication.
Run DESeq2 with an explicitly oriented contrast (treated vs control) so a positive log2FoldChange means up in treated.

plan.rationale: Cross-condition DE via the cross_condition_de workflow: pseudobulk aggregation on raw counts (per sample x cell_type) followed by DESeq2 with an explicit, oriented treated-vs-control contrast to guard against the case/control swap. This path operates on raw counts and is separate from the clustering sequence.

plan.rationale: Multi-batch standard_scrnaseq run. Embedding-level Harmony integration (the 'harmony' primitive, which would run after pca) is NOT in this workflow's allowed_primitives in v0.x, so the planner must not propose it. Instead, per-batch HVG selection (batch_key='batch') mitigates batch-driven feature selection while staying inside the allowed set. If full embedding integration is required, the active workflow must be extended first (see AGENTS.md: no improvising outside declared workflows in v0.x).
